sections.heading: Glossary term: Triton
sections.body: Triton is the largest moon of the planet Neptune. It is larger than Pluto, and in fact, because of the unusual properties of its orbit and from what we know of its composition, Triton may well be a dwarf planet captured by Neptune. Triton has an icy surface, with water ice covered by a layer of frozen nitrogen, surrounding a mostly rocky core. Voyager 2, so far the only space probe to visit Triton, discovered that the moon is geologically active, with geysers blowing out nitrogen gas, and very probably with ice volcanoes ("cryovolcanoes") – analogous to Earth's volcanoes, but with water and ammonia instead of liquified rock.

Glossary term: Triton

Description: Triton is the largest moon of the planet Neptune. It is larger than Pluto, and in fact, because of the unusual properties of its orbit and from what we know of its composition, Triton may well be a dwarf planet captured by Neptune. Triton has an icy surface, with water ice covered by a layer of frozen nitrogen, surrounding a mostly rocky core. Voyager 2, so far the only space probe to visit Triton, discovered that the moon is geologically active, with geysers blowing out nitrogen gas, and very probably with ice volcanoes ("cryovolcanoes") – analogous to Earth's volcanoes, but with water and ammonia instead of liquified rock.

Related Terms:

  • Moons
  • Neptune
  • Pluto


See this term in other languages

Term and definition status: This term and its definition have been approved by a research astronomer and a teacher

The OAE Multilingual Glossary is a project of the IAU Office of Astronomy for Education (OAE) in collaboration with the IAU Office of Astronomy Outreach (OAO). The terms and definitions were chosen, written and reviewed by a collective effort from the OAE, the OAE Centers and Nodes, the OAE National Astronomy Education Coordinators (NAECs) and other volunteers. You can find a full list of credits here. All glossary terms and their definitions are released under a Creative Commons CC BY-4.0 license and should be credited to "IAU OAE".

sections.body_ru: Тритон — крупнейший спутник планеты Нептун. Он больше Плутона, и, судя по необычным свойствам его орбиты и сведениям о его составе, Тритон вполне может быть карликовой планетой, захваченной Нептуном. Его преимущественно каменистое ядро окружено ледяной оболочкой, на поверхности которой водяной лёд покрыт слоем замёрзшего азота. «Вояджер-2», пока единственный космический зонд, посетивший Тритон, обнаружил, что спутник геологически активен: на нём есть гейзеры, выбрасывающие газообразный азот, и, весьма вероятно, ледяные вулканы («криовулканы») — аналогичные земным вулканам, но с водой и аммиаком вместо расплавленной породы.

Related Media


Neptune’s Moon Triton Fosters Rare Icy Union

Caption: An image of Neptune's moon Triton taken by NASA's Voyager 2 spacecraft. This image covers the south pole region of Triton. Triton's surface is covered by an icy mix of frozen nitrogen, water and carbon dioxide. Below the surface some of these compounds are thought to be in a liquid state. These liquids can burst out of the surface through geysers. These geysers produce the dark streaks seen in this image.

media.caption_en: An image of Neptune's moon Triton taken by NASA's Voyager 2 spacecraft. This image covers the south pole region of Triton. Triton's surface is covered by an icy mix of frozen nitrogen, water and carbon dioxide. Below the surface some of these compounds are thought to be in a liquid state. These liquids can burst out of the surface through geysers. These geysers produce the dark streaks seen in this image.
media.caption_ru: Изображение спутника Нептуна Тритона, полученное космическим аппаратом НАСА «Вояджер-2». Это изображение охватывает область южного полюса Тритона. Поверхность Тритона покрыта ледяной смесью замороженного азота, воды и углекислого газа. Под поверхностью некоторые из этих соединений, как считается, находятся в жидком состоянии. Эти жидкости могут вырываться из поверхности через гейзеры. Эти гейзеры создают тёмные полосы, видимые на этом изображении.
media.alt_en: Triton is a spherical moon covered in areas of different shades of light grey. Short dark streaks pepper this landscape.
media.alt_ru: Тритон — сферический спутник, покрытый участками разных оттенков светло-серого цвета. Короткие тёмные полосы усеивают этот ландшафт.
